_note: Narrator voice for every Reaping Trials video. The API key is NEVER stored here: it comes from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (or your local .env).
_post: applied after generation, no extra credits: tempo = speed-up with the same pitch, max_pause = longest pause kept inside a line (seconds), pitch = semitones up (+) or down (-) with the same speed (done in the mix)
_rise: word⬆ in a NARRATION line: the voice glides up over the marked words, up to this many semitones at the end (same recording, no credits)
